    4 class Battle
    5   unless @__clauses__aliased
    6     alias __clauses__pbDecisionOnDraw pbDecisionOnDraw
    7     alias __clauses__pbEndOfRoundPhase pbEndOfRoundPhase
    8     @__clauses__aliased = true
    9   end
   10 
   11   def pbDecisionOnDraw
   12     if @rules["selfkoclause"]
   13       if self.lastMoveUser < 0
   14         # in extreme cases there may be no last move user
   15         return 5   # game is a draw
   16       elsif opposes?(self.lastMoveUser)
   17         return 2   # loss
   18       else
   19         return 1   # win
   20       end
   21     end
   22     return __clauses__pbDecisionOnDraw
   23   end
   24 
   25   def pbJudgeCheckpoint(user, move = nil)
   26     if pbAllFainted?(0) && pbAllFainted?(1)
   27       if @rules["drawclause"]   # NOTE: Also includes Life Orb (not implemented)
   28         if !(move && move.function_code == "HealUserByHalfOfDamageDone")
   29           # Not a draw if fainting occurred due to Liquid Ooze
   30           @decision = (user.opposes?) ? 1 : 2   # win / loss
   31         end
   32       elsif @rules["modifiedselfdestructclause"]
   33         if move && move.function_code == "UserFaintsExplosive"   # Self-Destruct
   34           @decision = (user.opposes?) ? 1 : 2   # win / loss
   35         end
   36       end
   37     end
   38   end
   39 
   40   def pbEndOfRoundPhase
   41     __clauses__pbEndOfRoundPhase
   42     if @rules["suddendeath"] && @decision == 0
   43       p1able = pbAbleCount(0)
   44       p2able = pbAbleCount(1)
   45       if p1able > p2able
   46         @decision = 1   # loss
   47       elsif p1able < p2able
   48         @decision = 2   # win
   49       end
   50     end
   51   end
   52 end

   57 class Battle::Battler
   58   unless @__clauses__aliased
   59     alias __clauses__pbCanSleep? pbCanSleep?
   60     alias __clauses__pbCanSleepYawn? pbCanSleepYawn?
   61     alias __clauses__pbCanFreeze? pbCanFreeze?
   62     alias __clauses__pbUseMove pbUseMove
   63     @__clauses__aliased = true
   64   end
   65 
   66   def pbCanSleep?(user, showMessages, move = nil, ignoreStatus = false)
   67     selfsleep = (user && user.index == @index)
   68     if ((@battle.rules["modifiedsleepclause"]) || (!selfsleep && @battle.rules["sleepclause"])) &&
   69        pbHasStatusPokemon?(:SLEEP)
   70       if showMessages
   71         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But {1} couldn't sleep!", pbThis(true)))
   72       end
   73       return false
   74     end
   75     return __clauses__pbCanSleep?(user, showMessages, move, ignoreStatus)
   76   end
   77 
   78   def pbCanSleepYawn?
   79     if (@battle.rules["sleepclause"] || @battle.rules["modifiedsleepclause"]) &&
   80        pbHasStatusPokemon?(:SLEEP)
   81       return false
   82     end
   83     return __clauses__pbCanSleepYawn?
   84   end
   85 
   86   def pbCanFreeze?(*arg)
   87     if @battle.rules["freezeclause"] && pbHasStatusPokemon?(:FROZEN)
   88       return false
   89     end
   90     return __clauses__pbCanFreeze?(*arg)
   91   end
   92 
   93   def pbHasStatusPokemon?(status)
   94     count = 0
   95     @battle.pbParty(@index).each do |pkmn|
   96       next if !pkmn || pkmn.egg?
   97       next if pkmn.status != status
   98       count += 1
   99     end
  100     return count > 0
  101   end
  102 end

  240 #===============================================================================
  241 # Self-Destruct
  242 #===============================================================================
  243 class Battle::Move::UserFaintsExplosive
  244   unless method_defined?(:__clauses__pbMoveFailed?)
  245     alias __clauses__pbMoveFailed? pbMoveFailed?
  246   end
  247 
  248   def pbMoveFailed?(user, targets)
  249     if @battle.rules["selfkoclause"]
  250       # Check whether no unfainted Pokemon remain in either party
  251       count = @battle.pbAbleNonActiveCount(user.idxOwnSide)
  252       count += @battle.pbAbleNonActiveCount(user.idxOpposingSide)
  253       if count == 0
  254         @battle.pbDisplay("But it failed!")
  255         return false
  256       end
  257     end
  258     if @battle.rules["selfdestructclause"]
  259       # Check whether no unfainted Pokemon remain in either party
  260       count = @battle.pbAbleNonActiveCount(user.idxOwnSide)
  261       count += @battle.pbAbleNonActiveCount(user.idxOpposingSide)
  262       if count == 0
  263         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s team was disqualified!", user.pbThis))
  264         @battle.decision = (user.opposes?) ? 1 : 2
  265         return false
  266       end
  267     end
  268     return __clauses__pbMoveFailed?(user, targets)
  269   end
  270 end
